Nikon z7ii Body & Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 20mm f/1.8G ED Lens
$1,200

Yep — this is solid. I’d just clean up a few awkward bits and fix the reseller names so it reads more polished without changing your meaning:

**Nikon Z7 II Body + Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 20mm f/1.8G ED Lens**

This is a powerhouse camera body. I’ve used the Z7 II for professional work for several years and have loved shooting with it.

The Z7 II is a **45.7MP full-frame mirrorless camera** with incredible detail and dynamic range, in-body image stabilization, eye-detect autofocus, dual card slots, 4K/60 video, and a rugged professional build. It’s an amazing camera for landscapes, weddings, portraits, commercial work, travel, and anyone who wants huge, detailed files with plenty of room to crop.

The body is in great shape overall and performs beautifully. The only issue is a small fault with the rear LCD screen. I almost always shoot through the electronic viewfinder, so it never really bothered me. I’ve uploaded a video and included a couple photos of the back of the camera in Live View showing the LCD fault so there are no surprises. **It does not affect the sensor, image quality, autofocus, files, or shooting through the viewfinder.**

Also available separately is my **Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 20mm f/1.8G ED**. It’s an awesome ultra-wide lens — fast f/1.8 aperture, sharp, lightweight, and especially great for landscapes, astrophotography, concerts, interiors, travel, and environmental portraits.

**Important:** The 20mm is an **F-mount lens**, originally used with my Nikon D850. To use it on the Z7 II, you’ll need a Nikon **FTZ or FTZ II adapter**. If you want both the body and lens, I’m happy to work out a package price that helps offset the additional cost of the adapter.

Selling because I’m downsizing gear.

**$1,200 OBO for the body**  
**$400 OBO for the lens**

These prices are already very low compared with current pricing from trusted used-camera resellers like Adorama, KEH, and B&H, but I’m open to reasonable offers in that ballpark for either one because I’d like to make a quick sale this week.
